findings.summary: scripts/route-dispatch-run.js extractStateRouteInfo fallback (lines 137-141) assigns persistedRoute from any file-wide route: + indented actual_route when the top-level route block has no non-empty actual_route. scripts/validate-phase.js readPersistedRouteInfo only accepts indent-0 route:. Nested route.actual_route lets dispatch continue while validate-phase fails closed. Breaks REQ-routing-016 parser parity.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Nested-only and top-level route: without actual_route plus nested route.actual_route fixtures make extractStateRouteInfo and readPersistedRouteInfo report identical persistedRoute and routeSectionPresent. Policy-bound missing top-level actual_route still fails closed with no nested substitution. Focused tests cover both fixtures.

findings.summary: REQ-routing-016 parser parity is incomplete: extractStateRouteInfo fallback matches any route: + indented actual_route, including nested blocks, and sets persistedRoute without setting routeSectionPresent. readPersistedRouteInfo only enters indent-0 route: and has no fallback. Indented route.actual_route is accepted by the dispatcher and ignored by validate-phase.
findings.acceptance_criteria: For indented/nested route:+actual_route fixtures and the existing column-0 cases, both parsers return identical persistedRoute and routeSectionPresent. Remove the dispatcher-only regex fallback or share one parser. Add a regression test that fails if they disagree on the indented fixture.
